name: Azad Hotel
description: Set up in 1940 and credited locally with introducing biryani to the city. The first outlet is close to the Padmanabhaswamy Temple.

name: Villa Maya
description: Described as one of the city's traditional 'Ammaveedu' family-style houses, known for appam with stew and fish curries.

name: Indian Coffee House (Central Station Road)
description: The best-known outlet of the co-operative coffee house chain, in a distinctive red-brick building. Better for coffee and juices than for a big meal, according to one reviewer.

name: Hotel Mubarak (Meen Kada)
description: A long-running fish eatery known for generous helpings of fried fish.

name: Sree Guruvayoorappan Hotel
description: A roughly 50-year-old eatery known for traditional kanji (rice gruel) in four varieties and unusual snacks.

name: Ezhuthanikada
description: A family-run eatery of about 70 years with no name board and old wooden shutters, known for coin parotta, mutton curry and vettu cake.

name: Vattakuzhikkal Toddy Shop
description: A family-friendly toddy shop known for its spicy beef roast.

name: Chandrettan's Meenkada
description: A simple fish-curry-and-rice spot a few kilometres from Kollam city.

name: Salim Hotel
description: A local favourite for mutton dishes. 'Think mutton, think Salim' is a saying among Kollam food-lovers.

name: Hotel Aryaas Park
description: A vegetarian restaurant in Thiruvalla, praised by a reviewer as one of the best vegetarian places in Kerala. This rests on a single reviewer's opinion.

name: Brothers Restaurant
description: Known for its duck roast and a legacy of over 40 years.

name: Damodara Hotel
description: Famous for duck and fresh-water fish recipes, with a view of the lake.

name: Vanchiveedu
description: A backwater restaurant where freshwater fish is the highlight.

name: Aatumukham
description: A Kuttanad eatery serving duck mappas and fish dishes.

name: Chungam Shaap
description: A traditional Kuttanad toddy shop known for its shaap curry.

name: Karimpinkala
description: A toddy shop that opened in 1958 and became a well-known family restaurant, serving karimeen pollichathu, crab roast, duck roast and fish head curry.

name: Padippura Toddy Shop
description: Popular for tapioca with varaal (snakehead fish) curry and beef dishes.

name: Kumarakom Toddy Parlour
description: Given 'model toddy parlour' status by the government, according to Onmanorama, and known for local fish dishes.

name: Kilikkoodu Toddy Shop
description: A toddy shop known for duck curry and pearl-spot dishes, with no vegetarian options.

name: Mahaveer Veg Restaurant
description: Listed among the top restaurants in Idukki by Holidify, a vegetarian option in Munnar.

name: Athidhi Restaurant
description: Listed among the top restaurants in Idukki by Holidify.

name: Sun Mount View
description: Listed among the top restaurants in Idukki by Holidify.

name: Kayees Rahmathulla Hotel
description: A famous Kochi biryani house, established in 1948, linked with the 'Kayikka biryani' tradition.
address: Mattancherry, with a branch near Durbar Hall Ground, Ernakulam

name: Bharath Coffee House
description: Opened on 26 January 1956 and seating about 110. Guides suggest its karimeen, Syrian beef fry and prawn curry.

name: Mullapanthal Toddy Shop
description: A toddy shop reported to be around 87 years old, known for toddy with spicy bar food.

name: Hotel Bharath
description: A pure-vegetarian landmark said to date from the 1960s, serving a sadya without garlic. Expect queues at peak hours.

name: Sree Radhakrishna Coffee Club
description: Started in 1943, among the oldest vegetarian restaurants in town, known for breakfast.

name: Indian Coffee House (Thrissur Round)
description: Described as the first Indian Coffee House in Kerala, long a meeting place for writers and artists.

name: Goal Face Hotel
description: Famous since the early 1980s for its porotta and beef combination.

name: Noorjehan's Open Grill
description: Known for its tandoori chicken and grilled dishes.

name: Kapilavastu
description: Known for chemmeen ularthiyathu, a spicy prawn dry roast.

name: Hotel Gazala
description: Known for chicken biryani.

name: Hotel Delicia
description: A frequently listed restaurant with an air-conditioned dining hall.
address: Delicia Complex, near Municipal Bus Stand, Malappuram

name: Airlines Celestial Family Restaurant
description: Described as one of the most famous restaurants in Malappuram town for Kerala cuisine.

name: Paragon Restaurant
description: Opened in 1939 and ranked 11th in TasteAtlas's list of the world's 150 most legendary restaurants, with biryani as its signature. It began as a bakery.

name: Hotel Rahmath
description: Known for beef biryani, with a heavy daily rush, around five decades old.

name: Bombay Hotel
description: One of the city's oldest running eateries, known beyond biryani for chattippathiri, elanchi and mutton cutlet.

name: French Bakery
description: A bakery dating to 1932, remembered as a hangout of the colonial era.

name: Green Gates
description: Noted for pepper-flavoured Kerala food and Chinese dishes, per a 2018 roundup.

name: 1980's A Nostalgic Restaurant
description: A restaurant for Kerala meals in Kalpetta, known for service.

name: Paris Restaurant
description: Founded in 1942 by M. K. Mohammed Haji, credited as the birthplace of Thalassery dum biryani (now called Paris Presidency).

name: Rara Avis
description: One of the two restaurants most often named for Thalassery biryani.

name: National Hotel
description: Noted for Thalassery biryani and seafood.

name: Manna
description: A Malabar-cuisine restaurant presented as one of the district's leading places for traditional Kasaragod food.

name: Naalukettu Restaurant
description: Popular for authentic Kerala cuisine in a traditional setting.
